structured.approach: I loaded the requirement-steps skill for REQ-08 and read the four contracted inputs: the approved PRD, prototype and TRD, plus org.templates. To ground the tasks and boundary criteria I also read the existing unit test files in ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_aging, and predict.py in ap_forecast. I split the work into one epic and five features, one feature per repository and lane following the TRD routing. Under them are eight stories in NEW state, each with tasks. Every story follows the template (ID, title, As a/I want/So that, Gherkin acceptance criteria, assumptions, open items) and also gives PRD/TRD traces, frame links, dependencies and a specification depth. Frame links point to the prototype's text frames (SC-1, WF-1, WF-2, flows 4.1 and 4.2), because Figma is not connected. Interim TRD designs that depend on an open question are written as acceptance criteria marked [Pending <ID>]. I set no priority or estimate, because that is not a Requirement agent action. A verifier subagent checked the draft and found 11 issues: criteria that rest on open questions but had no marker, overstated wording, one uncited sentence, and one unsupported task. I fixed all of them. As a result every story is now D2, and I added a short note explaining why.

claims.text: The story template requires ID, title, As a/I want/So that, acceptance criteria in Gherkin (Given/When/Then), assumptions and open items; every story in feat.stories follows it.
Work is split into one feature per lane: ap_pipeline to Data Engineering, ap_forecast to Data Science, ap_aging to Backend, ap_portal to Frontend, and the end-to-end story to the Testing Agent.
The eight stories cover PRD acceptance criteria AC-1 to AC-23 and user stories US-1 to US-5 without adding scope beyond S-1 to S-7.
Every TRD test T-1 to T-17 maps to at least one story acceptance criterion.
An unpaid invoice exactly 30 days past due is not listed, and one at 31 days is listed (AC-05.1, AC-05.2), using prototype rows SYN-INV-001 and SYN-INV-005.
vendor_risk returns 'medium' for a predicted delay of exactly 30 and 'low' for exactly 10; predict_delay_days is a rounded mean that counts negative delays as 0 and returns 0 for an empty history.
Amounts stay Decimal quantised to two decimals in ap_aging, travel as two-decimal strings in CT-1 (for example "1250.00"), and are never formatted through a float in ap_portal.

STORY-02 depends on STORY-01; STORY-06 depends on STORY-05; STORY-07 depends only on the CT-1 contract; STORY-08 depends on STORY-01, 02, 03, 05, 06 and 07. External dependencies are feed v3 (PQ-6) and PROV-ACME-2026-11 (PQ-5).
Frame links reference the prototype's text frames SC-1, WF-1, WF-2 and flows 4.1 and 4.2, because Figma is not connected (PQ-P6).
Each lane must keep CI green with coverage of at least 90%; the Python repos are on Python 3.9 and ap_portal on Node.js 22.
New unit tests are placed in the existing test files tests/test_pipeline.py, tests/test_forecast.py and tests/test_aging.py, which exist in the repositories.
All stories are in NEW state, and no priority, iteration or estimate is set.
No conflict with D-2026-031, D-2026-044 or D-2026-050 was found. The prototype-vs-TRD difference on padding a one-decimal amount is already raised as TQ-11 and is kept pending in AC-07.6.

open_questions: SQ-1: Priority, iteration and estimates for STORY-01 to STORY-08 are not set (backlog prioritisation is for the PM).
SQ-2: Should TQ-1 (bucket_for(30) returns "31-60") and TQ-2 (formatAmount formats through a float) become separate NEW items? They are out of scope here, so no story was written for them.
SQ-3: The TRD was approved, but no input records answers to TQ-1 to TQ-11. Were any answered at the REQ-07 gate, in particular TQ-3 (CT-1 approval)? Answers would lift the [Pending] markers.

SQ-4: Definition of ready: must the pending items (OQ-B6, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, PQ-1, PQ-2, PQ-5, PQ-P7, TQ-3 to TQ-11) be answered before stories enter an iteration, or may lanes start on the interim designs?
Carried unchanged: OQ-B1 to OQ-B10, PQ-1 to PQ-6, PQ-P1 to PQ-P7, TQ-1 to TQ-11, FQ-3/FQ-5/FQ-6, OQ-1 to OQ-5 and Q-1 to Q-5, each mapped to the stories it affects in section 6.2.
structured.summary: I wrote feat.stories for FEAT-ZD-48600. It splits the work into 1 epic, 5 features (one per lane), 8 stories and their tasks. All stories are in NEW state. Every story has numbered Gherkin acceptance criteria, PRD and TRD traces, links to the prototype's text frames, dependencies, a specification depth, assumptions and open items. Every PRD criterion (AC-1 to AC-23) and every TRD test (T-1 to T-17) maps to a story. Criteria that rest on open questions are marked [Pending <ID>], so all eight stories are at depth D2. No conflict was found with the decision log or any approved output. A verifier pass found 11 issues, and I fixed all of them. Four new non-blocking questions (SQ-1 to SQ-4) are raised for the PM and Architect. No question is blocking.
